matches.quote: To generate the bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical provider reimbursement reports on claims per provider, using standard or customized report formats as specified for MSIU.

The user requests generation of the bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical provider reimbursement report on claims per provider, based on the VSP payment terms, using the standard report format specified for MSIU.
The system generates the provider reimbursement report on claims per provider from the processed claim data stored in the Database.

If the report required for the reporting period must be produced in a customized format rather than the standard report format, the system generates the customized financial and medical provider reimbursement report.

If the payment terms agreed by the VSP call for a bi-monthly reporting period rather than a monthly one, the bi-monthly financial and medical provider reimbursement report is generated for that period.

UC-0322f7e7255c507e-R0001.rationale: The goal, main flow, and alternative flow explicitly cover generating bi-monthly or monthly reports based on VSP payment terms, including standard and customized formats. The main flow shows the user requesting the report and the system generating it, while alternative flows address customized formats and bi-monthly periods.

The system validates the submitted data, ensuring consistency and completeness.

The system confirms successful recording of the feedback to the user.

The client feedback record, including Voucher No, Client Details, Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, Satisfaction of Treatment, Satisfaction of counseling, Satisfaction of ensuring privacy, and Partner Treated, is successfully saved in the system database.
The data entered for the client feedback is available for future retrieval, reporting, and analysis within the Voucher Management System.

matches.quote: The MSIU Field Office User initiates claim entry in the Claim Processing system and enters the Treatment Form No; the system captures the Treatment Form No and Claim No.

S16-02-R0002.label: FULL

matches.quote: C2 JU has correlated local sensor data.
C2 JU recognizes that two tracks—one a local track or common local track and one a remote/interface track—are eligible for correlation.
C2 JU initiates action, either automatically or manually, to resolve the dual designation after recognizing that two tracks being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation.
The process of correlation consists of comparing locally derived sensor data (e.g., position, velocity, boost indication) with the data received on the interface.
When the two tracks pass the correlation tests and restrictions once, they are deemed a tentative correlation.
Upon the next correlation stimulus, the same two tracks are tested again.
When the two tracks successfully pass the second correlation test and there is no correlation restriction, they are processed for dual designation resolution.
C2 JU transmits the J7.2 Correlation message requesting all other C2 IUs to perform a correlation of the two tracks, identifying the track number to be retained and the track number to be dropped.

The receiving IUs accept the requested correlation unless certain prespecified conditions exist which require or allow the receiving IU to reject the requested correlation or respond with a reverse correlation request.
Upon successful correlation, if the originating C2 JU holds R² data for the Dropped TN, it transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message to drop the Dropped TN.

S16-02-R0002.rationale: All material aspects of the requirement are covered: the automatic correlation capability is demonstrated through the main flow steps (initiation, correlation process, tentative correlation, second test, J7.2 transmission, receiving IU response, J7.0 drop) triggered by the C2 JU recognizing eligible tracks and having correlated local sensor data. No contradictory statements exist, and all necessary elements are explicitly expressed.

S16-05-R0002.label: FULL

matches.quote: To transfer reporting responsibility (R^2) for a track by having a C2 JU relinquish or assume R^2 in accordance with the applicable R^2 rules.
C2 JU receives a remote track report for a real-time track.
C2 JU receives a remote track report with TQ greater than the local TQ for a real-time track.
Upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than the local TQ, the C2 JU relinquishes R^2 for the real-time track.

After applying all the applicable rules, upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN, the C2 JU relinquishes R^2 for the real-time track.
A C2 JU with R^2 retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the rules or until the track is dropped.

Common tracking shares a common track number and shifts R^2 between C2 JUs; each air, surface (maritime), land (ground), and space tracked object is normally reported by one C2 JU while other C2 JUs withhold their reports.

For air, surface, or land tracks, C2 JUs capable of assuming R^2 shall not transmit tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed; the minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds and for land tracks is 48 seconds.

If a locally derived ballistic missile track is uncorrelated with ballistic missile tracks reported on the Surveillance NPG, the C2 JU shall report on the uncorrelated local ballistic missile track and shall assume R^2 for that track in accordance with the R^2 rules.

If the track is a ballistic missile track, a unit assuming R^2 for the ballistic missile track need not assume R^2 for the associated launch point; the unit no longer holding R^2 on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with the transmit/receive rules.

S16-05-R0002.rationale: All clauses of S16-05-R0002 are covered: the goal (transfer R^2), main flow (receiving reports, relinquishing R^2, retention rules, transmission constraints, single reporting), and alternative flow (ballistic missile track reporting and R^2 rules) are explicitly expressed, ensuring only the JU with best data reports.

S16-05-R0003.label: FULL

matches.quote: To transfer reporting responsibility (R^2) for a track by having a C2 JU relinquish or assume R^2 in accordance with the applicable R^2 rules.
For Subsurface tracks, the first JU to report a contact assumes reporting responsibility for that Track Number.

For Subsurface tracks, it is often desirable that more than one JU report the same Subsurface contact using different TNs; the first JU to report a contact assumes reporting responsibility for that Track Number, and no other JU shall report the contact using that track number unless one of the specified conditions occurs, including receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message containing the TN.

S16-05-R0003.rationale: All clauses of S16-05-R0003 are covered: the goal (transfer R^2), postconditions (first JU assumes R^2 for subsurface track), and alternative flow (first JU assumption rule for subsurface tracks) are explicitly expressed.

S16-03-R0019.label: PARTIAL

matches.quote: If the R² JU identifies that an ID conflict exists, the operator shall be alerted and the local ID data shall continue to be reported in the appropriate surveillance message, with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 1.

If the Identity Difference Indicator is set to value 1 for a non-R² unit, the unit may either: (a) follow the actions in Table 4.7-2 while inhibiting transmission of the J7.0 (ACT = 1) message until a surveillance message is received with the Identity Difference Indicator reset to value 0; or (b) take no action with respect to the reported ID, with an operator alert provided as a system option.

When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert, the operator has the following manual actions available for attempting resolution of the difference: (1) update local data manually or verify automatic inputs; (2) initiate a J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message (any mode); (3) initiate a J7.5 (ACT = 1) IFF/SIF Difference Report message (any mode); (4) change local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code; (5) decorrelate the local data from the remote data, causing assignment of a new track number to the local data; and (6) clear the operator alert (any mode).

If any of the manual resolution actions result in resolution of the ID conflict, the track number to be retained shall be tested for decorrelation in accordance with paragraph 4.4.4.3.2a before executing the correlation, except that the test shall be conducted only once.

When erroneous codes are detected and there are no other valid codes available or changes are inhibited (as in Mode II code reporting), the system shall have a capability to delete or clear the erroneous codes so that the interface can return to a No Data status for the specified track and its corresponding mode(s).

When the Identity Difference Indicator is set to value 1, if the R² JU is directed to automatically reject the remote ID, the system shall discard the message and the track shall continue to be reported with local data.

S16-03-R0019.rationale: The generated output partially covers identity difference recognition and resolution through operator alerts and manual actions, but does not address transmitting the appropriate J7 message as specified in the requirement.

S16-03-R0019.label: FULL

matches.quote: The C2 JU detects an identity difference between locally held track identity and identity reported on the interface.
Interface procedures recognize and resolve ID differences; all IUs should hold the same common ID for a given track.

If an ID conflict exists (difference cannot be automatically accepted or rejected), the difference is presented to operators for evaluation, potentially requiring voice coordination for final resolution.

Identity differences are processed according to Table 4.7-2 framework, which specifies actions: NO ACTION (0), OPERATOR ALERT requiring manual action (1), ACCEPT received ID as local ID (2), or REJECT received ID (3).
The R² unit transmits the changed identity in the appropriate surveillance message at the next transmit opportunity with Identity Difference Indicator set to value 0.
The controlling unit of the track automatically rejects received ID data and transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 1) message with own unit data and Controlling Unit Indicator field set to value 1.

Non-R² units resolve ID differences in accordance with Table 4.7-2; if directed to automatically accept or reject, the system updates local ID or transmits J7.0 (ACT = 1) with local data respectively; otherwise, the operator is alerted and resolves the conflict.

S16-03-R0019.rationale: The generated output covers all aspects of recognizing and resolving identity differences: detecting differences, using interface procedures, presenting conflicts to operators, processing via Table 4.7-2, and actions for R² and non-R² units including transmitting J7 messages.

in accordance with section 4.4.4.3.1, Air and Surface Track Correlation.

S16-02-R0004.label: FULL

matches.quote: A C2 JU recognizes that two tracks which are being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation.
The C2 JU initiates action, either automatically or manually, to resolve the dual designation.
The recognizing JU transmits the J7.2 Correlation message requesting all other C² IUs to perform a correlation of the two tracks.
The J7.2 message identifies the TN to be retained and the TN to be dropped.

S16-02-R0004.rationale: All material clauses are expressed: recognition of eligible tracks reported to the interface, automatic or manual initiation, J7.2 transmission requesting correlation, and identification of retained and dropped TNs.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0001.label: FULL

matches.quote: The C2 JU coordinates with all IUs via voice or other communications media to minimize track management problems prior to activating interface filters.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0001.rationale: The generated output fully covers the requirement to coordinate interface filters with all IUs via voice or other media, as stated in the main flow.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0003.label: PARTIAL

matches.quote: if geographically defined, the transmit filter area shall be slightly larger than the reception area to prevent dual designations
if geographically defined, the transmit filter area is slightly larger than the reception area to prevent dual designations

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0003.rationale: The geographic condition, larger transmit area, and dual-designation prevention purpose are expressed. However, the qualifier 'where possible' and the requirement that 'tracks entering or leaving the filtered area may be displayed to the operator' are omitted.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0004.label: PARTIAL

matches.quote: If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority.
If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0004.rationale: The conditions (storage full, all filters used) and result (acceptance not required regardless of ID/priority) are present, but the actor is generalized to 'a JU' instead of 'C2 JU', and the explicit applicability to 'both real-time and nonreal-time data' is missing.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0005.label: FULL

matches.quote: Any track or nonC² IU with an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1 shall not be filtered.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0005.rationale: The generated output fully covers the requirement that tracks or nonC2 IUs with EMG IND or FT IND set to 1 are not filtered.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0006.label: FULL

matches.quote: A J3.1 message shall not be filtered.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0006.rationale: The generated output fully covers the requirement that J3.1 messages are not filtered.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0007.label: FULL

matches.quote: Active nonsimulated C² IUs cannot be filtered; however, C² IUs with the Simulation Indicator field set in their J2 PPLI message may be filtered.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0007.rationale: The generated output fully covers the requirement that active nonsimulated C2 IUs cannot be filtered, but those with Simulation Indicator set may be filtered.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0008.label: FULL

matches.quote: Transmit filters are coordinated with all IUs via unique filter numbers to minimize track management problems.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0008.rationale: The generated output fully covers the requirement to identify filters by filter number for coordination with other JUs.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0009.label: FULL

matches.quote: Tracks eligible for transmission on the interface are those not inhibited by any currently set transmission filters.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0009.rationale: The generated output fully covers the requirement that tracks are eligible for transmission only if not inhibited by any currently set transmission filter.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0010.label: FULL

matches.quote: Filters apply to tracks initiated prior to filter activation as well as tracks initiated while the filter is active.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0010.rationale: The generated output fully covers the requirement that filters apply to tracks initiated before and during filter activation.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0011.label: FULL

matches.quote: Units cease reporting tracks for which they have R² and that meet filter criteria, complying with termination rules for applicable track data of the Environment/Category.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0011.rationale: The generated output fully covers the requirement that units cease reporting R2 tracks meeting filter criteria and comply with termination rules.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0012.label: FULL

matches.quote: The J7.2 Correlation message shall not be inhibited by any filter.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0012.rationale: The generated output fully covers the requirement that the J7.2 Correlation message is not inhibited by any filter.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0013.label: PARTIAL

matches.quote: The C2 JU sends a J7.6 (ACT = 0) Filter Implementation Request message to request activation of a transmit filter.
The C2 JU may send a J7.6 (ACT = 2) Delete Filter Request/Report message to remove an existing filter.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0013.rationale: J7.6 ACT=0 and ACT=2 messages are covered, but J7.6 (ACT=1) Filter Description Report and J7.1 (ACT=0) Data Update Request by Request Indicator messages are completely absent from the output.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0014.label: PARTIAL

matches.quote: The C2 JU sends a J7.6 (ACT = 0) Filter Implementation Request message to request activation of a transmit filter.
The J7.6 message mechanism is available for requesting or reporting insertion/deletion of transmit filters.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0014.rationale: J7.6 usage for transmit filters is expressed, but the exclusivity ('only applies to transmit filters'), inclusion of data forwarding filters, and the prohibition on requesting/reporting receive filters via Link 16 are not stated.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0015.label: NOT_COVERED
UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0015.rationale: The generated output does not cover the requirement to use the Filter Unit Type field to indicate whether a filter applies to individual JU transmissions or forwarding unit transmissions.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0016.label: NOT_COVERED
UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0016.rationale: The output contains no mention of forwarding-unit filters or the restriction against requesting/reporting filters for forwarding data from links other than Link 16 into Link 16.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0017.label: PARTIAL

matches.quote: The C2 JU coordinates with all IUs via voice or other communications media to minimize track management problems prior to activating interface filters.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0017.rationale: The generated output partially covers the requirement for voice coordination in addition to filter messages, as it mentions voice coordination but does not explicitly state it is required in addition to filter messages.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0019.label: NOT_COVERED
UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0019.rationale: The generated output does not cover the requirement to use J7.6 (ACT = 1) to report a filter inserted into its TDS or to respond to a J7.1 (ACT = 0) message, and set the filter number between 1 and 14.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0020.label: NOT_COVERED
UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0020.rationale: The generated output does not cover the requirement to address filter messages to the requesting JU when J7.6 (ACT = 1) is used in response to J7.1 (ACT = 0).

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0021.label: NOT_COVERED
UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0021.rationale: No claim states that a new filter report on a previously received filter number from the same JU supersedes prior filter data for that number.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0022.label: NOT_COVERED
UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0022.rationale: No claim addresses treating multiple J7.6 messages with the same filter number for a line or area filter as a single filter report.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0024.label: PARTIAL

matches.quote: Active nonsimulated C² IUs cannot be filtered; however, C² IUs with the Simulation Indicator field set in their J2 PPLI message may be filtered.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0024.rationale: The simulation filter exception for C2 IUs is expressed, but no claim states that J7.6 transmit filters do not apply to messages other than the listed J2, J3, and J12 series.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0029.label: NOT_COVERED
UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0029.rationale: The requirement specifies filtering EW fixes, AOPs, and LOBs based on geographic area and EW Filter Indicator. The output does not mention these specific EW product types or their filtering criteria.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0030.label: NOT_COVERED
UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0030.rationale: The requirement details filtering points, lines, and areas based on geographic area and Reference Point Filter Indicator. The output does not cover these specific filtering actions for reference points.

UC-5d871faa2b899b9a-R0031.label: NOT_COVERED

matches.quote: The C2 JU uses the J7.4 message to report or request cross-link track identifiers (NATO Link 1 TN, ATDL-1 TN, Link 11/11B TN, or IJMS SRN).

The C2 JU identifies the Link 16 TN or TNs for which the selected cross-link track identifier is requested, individually, collectively, or in any combination.

matches.quote: When a C2 JU recognizes that two tracks which are being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation, that JU initiates action, either automatically or manually, to resolve the dual designation.

S16-02-R0004.rationale: The generated output fully covers the requirement: the main flow explicitly states that when a C2 JU recognizes two eligible tracks, it initiates automatic or manual action to resolve the dual designation, transmits a J7.2 Correlation message requesting other IUs to perform correlation, and that the message identifies the TN to be retained and dropped (plus reverse correlation constraint), matching the reference's requirement exactly.

S16-07-R0002.label: CONTRADICTED

matches.quote: The Non-C2 JU sends a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing its own Track Number and appropriate JU Platform and System Status messages.
the Non-C2 JU responds with the requested surveillance information in a J3.4 message.

S16-07-R0002.rationale: Requirement mandates Non-C2 JU monitor the Surveillance NPG but prohibits transmitting on it. The output explicitly has the Non-C2 JU sending J7.1 and J3.4 messages, directly contradicting the transmission prohibition.

S16-07-R0003.label: CONTRADICTED

matches.quote: The Non-C2 JU sends a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing its own Track Number and appropriate JU Platform and System Status messages.

S16-07-R0003.rationale: The generated output explicitly states that the Non-C2 JU sends a J7.1 message, which contradicts the requirement that a Non-C2 JU shall not transmit on the Surveillance NPG.

S16-07-R0004.label: NOT_COVERED

The output only describes the Non-C2 JU providing/transmitting surveillance information, not using received J3-series data for situational awareness or early warning.

S16-07-R0005.label: NOT_COVERED

The output does not mention any of these message types or their monitoring; it only references J3.4 as a transmitted response.

S16-07-R0006.label: NOT_COVERED
S16-07-R0006.rationale: The generated output does not mention processing a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, for locally held remote tracks.

S16-07-R0007.label: NOT_COVERED

S16-07-R0009.rationale: The generated output does not mention terminating the force tell alert on all TNs in a segmented line or multisided area upon receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message clearing the force tell on any TN in the line or area.

S16-07-R0011.label: NOT_COVERED

matches.quote: The user accesses the first page of the two-page registration flow to create an account.
accessing the first page of the two-page registration flow to create an account, collect payment, and place bids

JTV-02-R0001.rationale: Output mentions a two-page registration flow and that Page 1 is for creating an account, collecting payment, and placing bids. matches.quote: The system generates an email to the email address provided containing a temporary password that the user should be advised to change.

JTV-02-R0003.rationale: The requirement specifies an automated transactional email with a thank-you message, instructions to enable cookies, and instructions to add email addresses to whitelist/Safe Senders list. The output instead describes an email containing a temporary password, which contradicts the specified email content.
